answer: Because the timing is written down against the velvet challenge, the vine audit can replay the violet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 160 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2466 identities would post 4788 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
